summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its virtual annual meeting held May 5, 2026. Shareholders elected eight director nominees, reappointed KPMG LLP as auditor, approved amendments to the share incentive plan, and passed an advisory resolution on executive compensation. Voting percentages show strong support for most proposals, though one director (Christiane Bergevin) received 75.99% for and 24.01% against. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure of proxy votes, not a special situation event.
